name: projet-00-myhappywallet-backend
description: Dans ce projet je mettrais toutes les tâches liées au Backend de mon projet "Chef d'oeuvre" CDA .

scripts.format: prettier --check package.json eslint.config.js .github AGENTS.md CONTRIBUTING.md changes docs/budget-reconciliation.md docs/analytics-api.md docs/budget-projection-api.md docs/daily-budget-domain.md docs/daily-budget-persistence.md docs/delivery-automation.md docs/development-toolchain-security.md docs/event-occurrence-resolutions.md docs/financial-goals.md docs/monthly-event-domain.md docs/monthly-event-persistence.md docs/operation-category-icons.md docs/fixed-operation-categories.md docs/jwt-issuer-audience.md docs/private-http-cache.md docs/release-process.md docs/request-logging.md docs/test-environment.md scripts/release.cjs test/release docs/runtime-dependency-security.md src/modules/user/mail/SendGridMailer.ts test/modules/user/SendGridMailer.test.ts test/modules/security/RuntimeDependencies.test.cjs

scripts.test:budget-period-migration: ts-node test/modules/budgetPeriods/BudgetPeriodMigration.test.ts prepare && prisma migrate deploy && ts-node test/modules/budgetPeriods/BudgetPeriodMigration.test.ts verify

scripts.test:repositories: ts-node test/modules/repositories/RepositoriesDataAccess.test.ts && npm run test:fixed-charge-migration && npm run test:fixed-charge-persistence && ts-node test/modules/operationsFixes/FixedCategoriesPersistence.test.ts
